scope: 11 frozen EDGAR accessions. The textual primary and Exhibit 99.1 when present (18 files).
method: Independent AI-assisted source reference, produced without viewing extractor code, predictions or another agent's labels. Each full SGML submission was read from the local source cache, the primary and EX-99 HTML files isolated by SGML type/sequence, and their text searched for event names and broader weather, interruption, insurance, closure and restoration terms. Candidate passages were read in context and matched against EDGAR pages or issuer copies. A targeted review of machine-readable text is not an exhaustive human annotation or an audit of images, all contract exhibits, earnings calls, or all publications by the companies.
unit: One explicitly stated, directly linked monetary amount per document/fact. Differences in the date a filing appears do not create a new financial fact. Qualitative statements, explicit absence of insurance proceeds without a numeric token, conditional risks, transaction prices and total company results are outside numeric scoring. An unallocated combined amount explicitly linked solely to the two target storms would count once.

coverage_values.complete_documents_targeted_text_review: All in-scope primary/99.1 files were available; absence of a supported amount means none found in this targeted review.
coverage_values.complete_document_targeted_text_review: Complete submitted document available for vocabulary search and targeted contextual inspection. Not a sentence-by-sentence annotation.
coverage_values.missing: An intended source was unavailable; exclude from the scored negative denominator.
